say:0:1660315001:0.text: Yikes... this fog. I can't see a thing. Stay sharp, everyone. Something nasty could be hiding in it.
say:0:1660315001:0.source_cn: 雾气好浓啊，能见度太低了，完全看不清四周的环境……大家...

say:1:1660315002:0.text: Looks like someone's been here before. Let's check the area. Maybe they left some notes or clues behind.
say:1:1660315002:0.source_cn: 嗯，这里似乎有人进来过，我们沿路找找看，也许会有人留下...
